sequence: After release:check, the shared admin button-label contrast and selector focus styling were refined. The affected browser tests, full production build, packaged-file integrity and rendered-reader tests were rerun. The Worker harness was updated to assert the current v4 backup contract and exercise the new routes.

hosting.reason: The official Site source Git fetch returned malformed shallow-history protocol responses, including expected ACK/NAK. Reproduced with a clean checkout; source was not overwritten.

limits: Browser tests use Chromium with synthetic material, actual application routes and a SQLite D1-shaped adapter plus in-memory object storage.
Built Worker smoke tests and existing storage tests use Miniflare; no claim of production D1 validation.
Physical-device touch testing and complete advanced-form coverage remain outside this increment.
Research journal migration must be applied by the normal private deployment workflow.
